name: Garlic Hummus by Best Foods® and Hellmann's®

ingredients.name: Best Foods® or Hellmann's® Garlic Mayo Aioli Dip & Spread

instructions.primary_message: Process all ingredients in food processor or blender until smooth; season, if desired, with salt and pepper.
Spread onto a platter and garnish, if desired, with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of paprika. Serve with your favorite dippers.
CHEF'S TIP: Customize by stirring in finely chopped pitted olives, roasted red peppers, caramelized onions, spicy harissa seasoning or any of your favorite hummus mix-ins.
